command: DO $$ DECLARE k text; u text; BEGIN SELECT decrypted_secret INTO k FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name = 'analytics_service_key'; SELECT decrypted_secret INTO u FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name = 'analytics_base_url'; PERFORM net.http_post(url := u || '/api/match/cron-recompute', headers := jsonb_build_object('Content-Type', 'application/json', 'X-Service-Key', k), body := '{}'::jsonb, timeout_milliseconds := 60000); END $$
